guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_mem rose +216.8% (z=+43.35) and its sockets doubled (z=+20.75), the two strongest anomalies in the digest, while every other series shows only small changes and CPU values mostly fell. The worst traces (7.7-8.2 s) all pass through currencyservice with errors surfacing in frontendservice, consistent with a slow or failing currencyservice, though the logs are empty and the service map does not list currencyservice -> productcatalogservice, so the trace path is somewhat inconsistent.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the currencyservice pods to release the leaked memory and sockets, set a memory limit, and then investigate the leak (for example a recent change or unclosed connections) before restoring normal traffic.
